name: IoT Sensor Ingestion
description: Simulates an IoT platform ingesting high-volume sensor readings from thousands of devices, with periodic aggregation queries for dashboards and alerting. Tests INSERT-heavy throughput with analytical read patterns.

setup_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS iot_devices (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), device_name STRING NOT NULL, device_type STRING NOT NULL, location STRING NOT NULL, status STRING NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', registered_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), INDEX idx_devices_type (device_type), INDEX idx_devices_location (location))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS iot_readings (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), device_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES iot_devices(id), metric_name STRING NOT NULL, metric_value DECIMAL(15,4) NOT NULL, unit STRING NOT NULL, recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), INDEX idx_readings_device_time (device_id, recorded_at DESC), INDEX idx_readings_metric (metric_name, recorded_at DESC))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS iot_alerts (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), device_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES iot_devices(id), alert_type STRING NOT NULL, severity STRING NOT NULL, message STRING NOT NULL, acknowledged BOOL NOT NULL DEFAULT false, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), INDEX idx_alerts_severity (severity, created_at DESC))
seed_sql: INSERT INTO iot_devices (id, device_name, device_type, location, status) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), 'sensor-' || generate_series::STRING, CASE (generate_series % 4) WHEN 0 THEN 'temperature' WHEN 1 THEN 'humidity' WHEN 2 THEN 'pressure' ELSE 'motion' END, CASE (generate_series % 3) WHEN 0 THEN 'warehouse-A' WHEN 1 THEN 'warehouse-B' ELSE 'warehouse-C' END, 'active' FROM generate_series(1, 500)

operations.name: ingest_reading
sql: INSERT INTO iot_readings (device_id, metric_name, metric_value, unit, recorded_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, now())

operations.name: batch_ingest
sql: INSERT INTO iot_readings (device_id, metric_name, metric_value, unit) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
INSERT INTO iot_readings (device_id, metric_name, metric_value, unit) VALUES ($1, $2, $5, $4)
INSERT INTO iot_readings (device_id, metric_name, metric_value, unit) VALUES ($1, $2, $6, $4)

operations.name: latest_readings_by_device
sql: SELECT r.metric_name, r.metric_value, r.unit, r.recorded_at FROM iot_readings r WHERE r.device_id = $1 ORDER BY r.recorded_at DESC LIMIT 10

operations.name: aggregation_dashboard
sql: SELECT d.device_type, d.location, COUNT(r.id) as reading_count, AVG(r.metric_value) as avg_value, MAX(r.metric_value) as max_value, MIN(r.metric_value) as min_value FROM iot_devices d JOIN iot_readings r ON r.device_id = d.id WHERE r.recorded_at > now() - INTERVAL '5 minutes' GROUP BY d.device_type, d.location ORDER BY reading_count DESC

operations.name: threshold_alert
sql: SELECT metric_value FROM iot_readings WHERE device_id = $1 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1
INSERT INTO iot_alerts (device_id, alert_type, severity, message) VALUES ($1, 'threshold_exceeded', 'warning', 'Sensor value above threshold')

operations.name: device_status_check
sql: SELECT d.id, d.device_name, d.status, d.location, COUNT(a.id) as unack_alerts FROM iot_devices d LEFT JOIN iot_alerts a ON a.device_id = d.id AND a.acknowledged = false WHERE d.location = $1 GROUP BY d.id, d.device_name, d.status, d.location ORDER BY unack_alerts DESC LIMIT 50
